sentences.en: Only in love are unity and duality not in conflict.
sentences.zh: 只有在爱情中，统一与二元性才不会产生冲突。

sentences.en: Leaders establish unity of purpose and direction of the organization.
sentences.zh: 领导者确立组织的目标一致性和方向一致性。

sentences.en: No one can deny the unity of the Berber language.
sentences.zh: 没有人能否认柏柏尔语的统一性。

senses.zh: 团结，统一；一致性，和谐；单一性，完整性
